segments.en: Today I practise computer English in a real conversation. I need to explain a small task clearly to another person. I say "memory" when I talk about my computer project. I say "RAM" when I talk about my computer project. I say "storage" when I talk about my computer project. I tell my teammate: Today I use memory, RAM, and storage. At the end, I say: I can use memory clearly today.

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“计算机英语”，场景是“内存与存储空间”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。memory：内存，程序运行时临时使用的快速空间。示例：I learned how to use "memory" in a computer task.RAM：随机存取存储器，电脑主要的运行内存。示例：I learned how to use "ram" in a computer task.storage：存储空间，长期保存文件和数据的空间。示例：I learned how to use "storage" in a computer task.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“计算机英语”，场景是“内存与存储空间”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。disk space：磁盘空间，硬盘或固态硬盘的可用容量。示例：I learned how to use "disk space" in a computer task.save to disk：保存到磁盘，把数据长期写入存储设备。示例：I learned how to use "save to disk" in a computer task.free up space：释放空间，删除或移动文件以增加可用容量。示例：I learned how to use "free up space" in a computer task.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“GitHub 项目英语”，场景是“代码评审”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。code review：代码评审，由他人检查代码质量和风险。示例：Our team uses "code review" to keep the project clear.review comment：评审评论，针对代码提出的意见。示例：Our team uses "review comment" to keep the project clear.approve changes：批准改动，表示评审者同意合并。示例：Our team uses "approve changes" to keep the project clear.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“GitHub 项目英语”，场景是“代码评审”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。request changes：要求修改，表示合并前仍需调整。示例：Our team uses "request changes" to keep the project clear.leave a comment：留下评论，对代码或讨论发表意见。示例：Our team uses "leave a comment" to keep the project clear.resolve a conversation：解决对话，标记某条评审讨论已处理。示例：Our team uses "resolve a conversation" to keep the project clear.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。
